timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: We already have logs. They are... somewhere.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: A tragic phrase. Security logs need central collection, retention, normalization, and alerting.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Identity sign-ins, admin actions, endpoint alerts, cloud control-plane events, and data access.

timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Can we just collect everything forever?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: If your budget enjoys combustion. Choose retention by investigation needs and regulatory requirements.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Sentinel correlates events, runs analytics, triggers automation, and supports hunting across sources.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Timestamp, actor, action, target, result, source IP, and enough context to answer what happened.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Precisely. Logs are the memory of your security program. Do not give it amnesia.
